entries.source: Freed the remnants of the Prides from the Internment Camp.
entries.target: 从拘留营中解救了各兽人部落的残部。

entries.source: You have spared the last remnants of the Atmos Tribe, showing mercy where others gave none to the orcs.
entries.target: 你饶恕了气之部族的最后成员，展现了兽人未曾得到的仁慈。

entries.source: Bend the mind, bend the tech. All around inspire dread.
entries.target: 扭曲精神，扭曲科技，令四周心生恐惧。

entries.source: The Psyshot combines this ability to gestalt to enhance his mindstar all the while shooting her steamgun to devastate the enemy lines.
entries.target: 灵能射手运用这种格式塔联结能力强化灵晶，同时以蒸汽枪射击，摧毁敌方阵线。

entries.source: More adept at technology than most other tinkers, they supplement their weapons with automated turrets, mechanical minions and other such devices.
entries.target: 他们比大多数其他工匠更精通技术，会用自动炮台、机械随从及其他类似装置来充实自己的武器库。

entries.source: They possess the #GOLD#Orcish Fury#WHITE# which allows them to increase all their damage for a few turns.
entries.target: 他们拥有 #GOLD#兽人之怒#WHITE#，让他们能在几回合内增加伤害。
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +2 力量，+1 敏捷，+1 体质
#LIGHT_BLUE# * -1 魔力，+1 意志，+1 灵巧

entries.source: Grave strength, dread will, this flesh cannot stay still. Kings die, masters fall, we will outlast them all.
entries.target: 死亡的力量，恐惧的意志，这些肉体不会沉寂。国王去世，主人陨落，我们才是永生。

entries.source: Undead are humanoids (Humans, Elves, Dwarves, ...) that have been brought back to life by the corruption of dark magics.
entries.target: 不死族是被黑暗魔法复活的人形生物（人类，精灵，矮人…）。

entries.source: Undead can take many forms, from ghouls to vampires and liches.
entries.target: 不死族有多种形态，从食尸鬼、吸血鬼到巫妖。

entries.source: A clan of minotaurs turned to necromancy when faced with imminent destruction.
entries.target: 一支米诺陶氏族在灭亡迫近时转而研究死灵法术。

entries.source: Whitehooves are resilient and magic imbued undead, hardened by their trials and made stronger by their undeath.
entries.target: 白蹄族是强韧而充满魔法力量的亡灵，在磨砺中变得坚韧，因不死而更加强大。

entries.source: They now seek to help their orc allies, in hope they will help them back.
entries.target: 他们现在试图帮助兽人盟友，希望兽人将来也能回报他们。

entries.source: They have access to #GOLD#special talents#WHITE# and a wide range of undead abilities:
entries.target: 他们拥有 #GOLD# 特殊天赋#WHITE# 和一系列不死族能力：

entries.source: - special whitehoof talents: dead hide, lifeless rush, essence drain
entries.target: - 特殊白蹄天赋：亡者之皮，无生突袭，吸取精华。
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +3 力量，-1 敏捷，+2 体质
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +2 魔力，-3 意志，+1 灵巧
